# react-form-wizard-component

> Accessible multi-step form wizard for React 17, 18 and 19. Zero runtime
> dependencies. Ships a styled component and a headless hook from one package,
> with per-step validation adapters for Zod and react-hook-form.

Package: `react-form-wizard-component` (npm, MIT)
Repository: https://github.com/parsajiravand/react-form-wizard
Docs: https://react-form-wizard-component-document.netlify.app

## Install

```bash
npm install react-form-wizard-component
```

Peer range: `react` and `react-dom` `^17 || ^18 || ^19`. No other dependencies.
Stylesheet: `import "react-form-wizard-component/styles.css"` (omit in
`unstyled` mode). The legacy path `react-form-wizard-component/dist/style.css`
still resolves.

## Exports

All from the package root:

- `default` / `FormWizard` — the styled component
- `TabContent` — a step, also available as `FormWizard.TabContent`
- `useWizard` — headless state machine
- `useWizardCursor` — step cursor only
- `useWizardData` — shared data only
- `zodValidator` — Zod-style schema → step validator
- `hookFormValidator` — react-hook-form field subset → step validator
- `composeValidators` — chain validators, first failure wins

Types: `FormWizardProps`, `FormWizardMethods`, `FormWizardSchema`,
`WizardStepSchema`, `WizardData`, `WizardTheme`, `WizardClassNames`,
`WizardPersistOptions`, `WizardUrlSyncOptions`, `WizardStepChangeEvent`,
`WizardCondition`, `WizardValidation`, `WizardValidationResult`,
`WizardConditionContext`, `WizardValidationContext`, `UseWizardOptions`,
`UseWizardReturn`, `TabContentProps`, `WizardTabProps`, `WizardButtonProps`.

## Minimal usage (children API)

```tsx
import FormWizard from "react-form-wizard-component";
import "react-form-wizard-component/styles.css";

<FormWizard onComplete={(data) => console.log(data)}>
  <FormWizard.TabContent title="Account">…</FormWizard.TabContent>
  <FormWizard.TabContent title="Review">…</FormWizard.TabContent>
</FormWizard>
```

## Schema API (conditional steps, per-step validation)

```tsx
import FormWizard, { type FormWizardSchema } from "react-form-wizard-component";

const schema: FormWizardSchema = {
  initialData: { plan: "basic" },
  steps: [
    { id: "plan", title: "Plan", content: <PlanPicker /> },
    {
      id: "billing",
      title: "Billing",
      condition: ({ data }) => data.plan === "premium",   // hide when false
      content: <BillingFields />,
    },
    {
      id: "review",
      title: "Review",
      validate: ({ data }) => (data.accepted ? true : "Accept the terms"),
      content: ({ data }) => <Review data={data} />,       // content can be a function
    },
  ],
};

<FormWizard schema={schema} onComplete={(data) => submit(data)} />;
```

Validator contract: return `true` to allow navigation, a `string` to block it
and supply the message, or `false` to block without a message.
`schema` takes precedence over children when both are supplied.

## Zod per-step validation

```tsx
import { z } from "zod";
import FormWizard, { zodValidator } from "react-form-wizard-component";

const account = z.object({ email: z.string().email("Enter a valid email") });

validate: zodValidator(account, { pick: ["email"] });  // pick = this step's fields
```

`zod` is not a dependency — the adapter accepts anything with `safeParse`
(Zod, Valibot, ArkType).

## react-hook-form per-step validation

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import FormWizard, { hookFormValidator } from "react-form-wizard-component";

const form = useForm({ mode: "onChange" });

validate: hookFormValidator(form, { fields: ["email", "phone"] });
```

Reads `formState.errors` only; it never mutates form state. Call
`form.trigger(fields)` yourself to populate errors.

## Headless

```tsx
import { useWizard } from "react-form-wizard-component";

const wizard = useWizard({
  stepIds: ["account", "profile", "review"],
  persist: { key: "signup" },        // optional
  syncToUrl: true,                   // optional, writes ?step=2
});

// wizard.currentStep, .maxVisitedStep, .totalSteps, .stepId
// wizard.isFirstStep, .isLastStep, .data
// wizard.next(), .previous(), .goTo(i), .goToId(id)
// wizard.reset(), .activateAll()
// wizard.setData(obj), .updateData(patch), .clearPersisted()
```

## Next.js App Router

The bundles include a `"use client"` directive, so importing `FormWizard` from
a server component works with no wrapper. Import the stylesheet once, commonly
in `app/layout.tsx`.

## Styling

Theme tokens become `--rfw-*` CSS custom properties on the wizard root:

```tsx
<FormWizard theme={{ primaryColor: "#0e6f70", borderRadius: "8px" }} />
```

Tokens: `primaryColor`, `backgroundColor`, `textColor`, `titleColor`,
`subtitleColor`, `tabColor`, `tabIconColor`, `borderColor`, `buttonColor`,
`buttonTextColor`, `finishButtonColor`, `finishButtonTextColor`, `errorColor`,
`borderRadius`.

Unstyled with your own classes:

```tsx
<FormWizard unstyled classNames={{ root: "…", step: "…", stepActive: "…", nextButton: "…" }} />
```

`classNames` keys: `root`, `header`, `title`, `subtitle`, `navigation`,
`stepList`, `step`, `stepActive`, `stepIcon`, `stepTitle`, `content`, `footer`,
`backButton`, `nextButton`, `finishButton`.

## Imperative control

```tsx
const ref = useRef<FormWizardMethods>(null);
<FormWizard ref={ref} schema={schema} />;

ref.current.nextTab();
ref.current.prevTab();
ref.current.goToTab(2);           // bypasses the visited-step gate
ref.current.goToTabById("review");
ref.current.reset();              // also clears persisted data
ref.current.activeAll();
ref.current.getData();
ref.current.setData({ … });
ref.current.updateData({ … });    // merges
ref.current.getCurrentStep();
```

## Key props

`title`, `subtitle`, `schema`, `data`, `onDataChange`, `onComplete`,
`onTabChange`, `color`, `theme`, `unstyled`, `classNames`, `shape`
(`circle`/`square`/`tab`), `stepSize` (`xs`/`sm`/`md`/`lg`), `layout`
(`horizontal`/`vertical`), `startIndex`, `showProgressBar`, `inlineStep`,
`disableBackOnClickStep`, `persist`, `syncToUrl`, `announceStepChanges`,
`keyboardNavigation`, `swipeNavigation`, `ariaLabel`, `nextButtonText`,
`backButtonText`, `finishButtonText`, `nextButtonTemplate`,
`backButtonTemplate`, `finishButtonTemplate`, `darkMode`,
`customDarkModeColor`, `removeBackgroundTab`, `style`.

## Accessibility

`role="region"` root; `tablist`/`tab`/`tabpanel` with `aria-selected`,
`aria-controls`, `aria-disabled`; `aria-live="polite"` step announcements;
focus moves to the panel on step change; Enter/Space activate a tab;
`←`/`→` move and `Home`/`End` jump. Multiple wizards on a page are isolated —
only the one containing focus responds to keys.

## Compatibility notes

- ESM, CJS (`require()`) and UMD builds; types verified with `attw` under
  `bundler`, `node16` (ESM and CJS) and `node10`.
- SSR-safe; storage and URL access are guarded and best-effort.
- React 17 works through any bundler. It cannot be loaded under **native Node
  ESM** because React 17 ships no `exports` field, so Node cannot resolve
  `react/jsx-runtime` — a React 17 limitation, not this package's.

## Common mistakes

- Forgetting the stylesheet import — the wizard renders unstyled. Import
  `react-form-wizard-component/styles.css` (not needed with `unstyled`).
- Expecting `validate` to run on submit only. It runs on every render, so keep
  it pure and cheap; it must not set state.
- Using `startIndex` to skip ahead. Steps beyond `maxVisitedStep` stay locked;
  use `ref.current.goToTab(i)` or `activeAll()` to unlock.
- Mutating the object passed to `setData`. Pass a new object; use `updateData`
  for partial changes.
